communityActivities.title: Sacramento Civic Tech & Open Transit Hackathon
communityActivities.description: Collaborate with regional developers and civic data scientists to build public transit route optimizers, air quality heatmaps, and open municipal APIs.

communityActivities.title: Youth Robotics League Championship Mentor & Tech Judge
communityActivities.description: Guide high school student teams through live PID motor debugging, sensor calibration, and autonomous routine inspection for regional competition.

communityActivities.title: Urban Canopy Tree Planting & Environmental IoT Sensor Deployment
communityActivities.description: Plant 60 native shade saplings and deploy low-power solar IoT soil moisture and ambient temperature sensors to monitor urban heat island reduction.

communityActivities.title: American River Parkway Native Flora & Riparian Restoration
communityActivities.location: American River Parkway · Mile 14 Habitat Zone
communityActivities.description: Restore native valley oak and elderberry buffer zones along critical riparian nesting habitats. Remove invasive yellow star-thistle and document regrowth.

communityActivities.title: NorCal Environmental Film Festival Screening & Media Lab
communityActivities.description: Community exhibition of student documentaries focusing on California watershed conservation. Includes post-screening panel with local cinematographers and sound designers.

communityActivities.title: UC Davis Arboretum 3D Photogrammetry & Digital Herbarium
communityActivities.organization: Sacramento Botanical Society & UC Davis Herbarium
communityActivities.description: Capture macro photographic series and 3D textured mesh photogrammetry of rare native California plants for the open public digital herbarium.

journals.title: Embedded RTOS Task Scheduling & Interrupt Latency
journals.summary: Benchmarked x86-64 timer interrupt latency and task context switching in autonomous rover motor controller. Handled 16-byte stack frame alignment in assembly ISR.
journals.keyInsight: Zero-latency ISR execution requires preserving caller registers on dedicated task stacks.

journals.title: C++20 RAII Custom Memory Arena Allocator
journals.summary: Built RAII custom memory pool arena in modern C++20 with std::unique_ptr custom deleters for continuous LIDAR point cloud buffer streaming.
journals.keyInsight: Arena memory pooling completely removes per-object heap allocation overhead in tight 60Hz loops.

journals.title: ROS2 PID Motor Control Tuning & GDB Telemetry
journals.summary: Inspected PID velocity feedback loops under varying wheel slip conditions. Calibrated deadband compensation in simulator.
journals.keyInsight: Derivative filtering prevents high-frequency motor chattering under noisy optical encoder reads.

dreams.title: Autonomous ROS2 Rover & Computer Vision Telemetry
dreams.description: Building a 4-wheel rover prototype using ROS2, LIDAR SLAM navigation, and real-time x86-64 embedded microcontroller telemetry.

dreams.title: Minimal x86-64 Bare-Metal Microkernel in Rust
dreams.description: Writing a 64-bit microkernel with custom multi-level paging, context switching, and lightweight message-passing IPC from scratch.

dreams.title: High-Performance Physics Simulation & Collision Engine
dreams.description: Developing a SIMD-accelerated particle collision and rigid body simulation engine in modern C++ with Vulkan compute pipelines.

roomMessages.text: Welcome Jordan and Alex! You have been paired by the Cross-Disciplinary Project Incubator. 🎉

Jordan brings low-level robotics and real-time sensor processing, while Alex brings 3D ecosystem rendering, foliage shaders, and field ecology research. You could build an incredible interactive nature simulation or wildlife sensor display together!

journals.title: Procedural Foliage Shaders & Subsurface Scattering in Blender
journals.summary: Created procedural shader nodes for California valley oak leaves in Blender Cycles. Simulated translucent subsurface scattering (SSS) for realistic canopy lighting.
journals.keyInsight: Microscopic light absorption depth in leaf mesh layers significantly enhances realism in forest canopies.

journals.title: Field Bioacoustic Spectrogram Analysis of Riparian Songbirds
journals.summary: Recorded ultrasonic vocalizations along the American River Parkway using directional shotgun microphones. Analyzed 4.5kHz frequency banding in Audacity & Python.
journals.keyInsight: Riparian songbirds elevate song pitch to overcome low-frequency urban roadway noise.

journals.title: Natural Light Cinematography & Color Grading in DaVinci Resolve
journals.summary: Graded 10-bit log footage shot at dusk along the river. Balanced shadow rolloff and warm golden-hour tones to highlight wetland reflections.
journals.keyInsight: Grading in ACES color space preserves extreme specular highlights on water ripples without clipping.

dreams.title: Interactive California Watershed 3D Ecosystem Simulation
dreams.description: Creating real-time procedural forest and river ecosystems in Unreal Engine 5 with procedural foliage shaders, dynamic weather, and live environmental feeds.

dreams.title: 'Voices of the Parkway' Short Documentary & Ambisonic Soundscape
dreams.description: Producing a 10-minute natural history short exploring nocturnal wildlife along the American River with ambisonic 3D spatial soundscapes.

dreams.title: Animated Nature Fantasy Short: 'The River's Edge'
dreams.description: Stylized anime/Ghibli-inspired short about a river spirit and urban encroachment using Blender Grease Pencil, cel shading, and painted background plates.
